name: @adreceipt/subgraph
description: The Graph indexer for AdReceipt settlement receipts.

scripts.build: npm run codegen && graph build subgraph.yaml
scripts.test: npm run codegen && graph test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.deploy:studio: npm run deploy:check && graph deploy "${SUBGRAPH_SLUG:-adreceipt}" subgraph.yaml --version-label "${SUBGRAPH_VERSION:-0.0.1}"
